item.title: Why Monte Carlo?
item.description: In 1997, chess fell to the machines. It was bound to happen. Despite there being more possible games of chess than atoms in the universe, with efficient move generation and a few optimizations and heuristics, its state tree becomes tractable to search. The average chess game lasts ~40 moves, a depth that a strong chess engine can reach on my…

item.title: AlphaPush
item.description: A whole four damn years ago, I wrote an "AI" that used Monte Carlo Tree Search to optimize and play a Magic: the Gathering deck. I put "AI" in quotes here because, as we now know in 2025, AI is neural networks. Ever since AlphaGo eked out a 4-1 victory against 9-dan professional Lee Sedol using MCTS and deep learning, I've wanted to replicate it…

item.title: Ford Tiles
item.description: Here's something weird: my game Tiles can now be found on the touchscreen in new Ford vehicles like the F-150 Lightning and Mustang Mach-E! I developed it for Ford last year, and now that the truck is out, I can finally show it off. It's a port/sequel to Quintacolor, which I made back in 2018!

item.title: Dicey Dungeons: Robo-JACKPOT!
item.description: Dicey Dungeons is a nice game! Since the advent of the roguelike deckbuilder, I'd been wondering if there's some design space away from the now-cliche deck of cards. Turns out: there is! It's dice. The game features 6 character classes, each with their own little twist, and one of them is the Robot, who comes with a neat little math problem. I'm…

item.title: Ludum Dare 48 Postmortem
item.description: Ludum Dare is a twice-annual event where participants try to make as good a game as possible in just 48 hours. After a 6th place finish last time, I was trying not to put too much pressure on myself this time, and... good, because Obelisk probably isn't top 10 material.

item.title: Ludum Dare 47 Postmortem
item.description: I had such high hopes for my last Ludum Dare game, even predicting a top 50, so let's see how we did... 362nd place?! Not gonna lie, I was disappointed. I have theories as to the reason, but really I was just itching for a shot at redemption. October couldn't come soon enough.

item.title: Ludum Dare 46 Postmortem
item.description: Jeez, my last Ludum Dare was a year ago?! The time, it does fly. And I hadn't finished any games since, so I was extremely ready to participate in this one. And participate I did! After a 20 minute brainstorm — my fastest ever, by far — I had my idea: part Rain World, part Mirror's Edge, and part Tamagotchi.
